strings.name: Iris van Herpen
strings.role: Fashion designer · Couture and material experimentation
strings.summary: Van Herpen treats couture as an experiment in body, movement and materials, combining handwork with processes such as 3D printing. Collaborations with artists, architects and scientists turn water, organisms and celestial forms into clothing. Her work has entered museums; recent collections range from a bioluminescent algae garment to designs inspired by stellar vibrations.

strings.influence.rationale: Combines couture, digital fabrication and material experiments, connecting fashion design with science, art and bodily expression.

strings.highlights.h1.title: Digital fabrication in couture
strings.highlights.h1.text: The 3D-printed garment in Crystallization in 2010 marked an important shift in her methods.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Collaborating on materials
strings.highlights.h2.text: Created a bioluminescent algae garment with Chris Bellamy, connecting biodesign and bodily movement.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Presented Sonic Starquakes
strings.timeline.t1.text: The Paris couture collection explored stellar vibrations, galactic geometries and plasma in clothing.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Retrospective reached Brooklyn
strings.timeline.t2.text: Celebrated Sculpting the Senses' North American debut, bringing fashion, art and science together.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Presented Sympoiesis
strings.timeline.t3.text: The ocean-focused collection included one look incorporating living bioluminescent algae.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Paris retrospective opened
strings.timeline.t4.text: The Musée des Arts Décoratifs launched Sculpting the Senses, which later toured internationally.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Became a guest couture member
strings.timeline.t5.text: Joined the Chambre Syndicale's guest membership and continued presenting collections in Paris.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Presented her first 3D-printed garment
strings.timeline.t6.text: Crystallization combined digital production and handwork to expand clothing's structural possibilities.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Founded her label
strings.timeline.t7.text: Started an independent career in Amsterdam, developing a language through cross-disciplinary experiments.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Completed design education
strings.timeline.t8.text: Graduated from ArtEZ and continued studio training, building the skills for her label.
